translations.web: Every priest indeed stands day by day serving and often offering the same sacrifices which can never take away sins,
translations.bsb: Day after day every priest stands to minister and to offer again and again the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins.
translations.kjv: And every priest standeth daily ministering and offering oftentimes the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins:
